  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.type,
  p.run,
  p.rerun,
  p.field,
  p.mode,
  p.clean,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,

rows.pred_sql:
WITH photoobj_canonical AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid::bigint AS objid,
    p.ra::double precision AS ra,
    p.dec::double precision AS dec,
    p.type::integer AS type,
    p.clean::integer AS clean
  FROM photoobj p
  WHERE p.objid IS NOT NULL
),
photo_type_lookup AS (
  SELECT
    pt.value AS value,
    upper(pt.name) AS name
  FROM photo_type pt
),
specobj_to_photoobj_link AS (
  SELECT
    s.specobjid::numeric AS specobjid,
    s.bestobjid::bigint AS bestobjid
  FROM specobj s
  WHERE s.bestobjid IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.objid AS object_id,
  p.ra AS right_ascension,
  p.dec AS declination
FROM photoobj_canonical p
JOIN photo_type_lookup t ON p.type = t.value
JOIN specobj_to_photoobj_link s ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
WHERE t.name = 'STAR'
  AND p.clean = 1
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.objid

rows.question: What is photometrically observed Galaxy
rows.pred_sql:
WITH gal_photo_type_val AS (
  SELECT value
  FROM photo_type
  WHERE name = 'Galaxy'
  LIMIT 1
),
-- specobj ids and bestobjids indicating a spectroscopic galaxy
spec_gal AS (
  SELECT s.specobjid, s.bestobjid
  FROM specobj s
  WHERE s.specobjid IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  -- include specobj rows referenced by galspecline (in case there are specobjids present only there)
  SELECT s.specobjid, s.bestobjid
  FROM galspecline g
  JOIN specobj s ON s.specobjid = g.specobjid
),
-- neighbor objids that reference any specobj.bestobjid as their neighborobjid
neighbor_objids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT n.objid
  FROM neighbors n
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM spec_gal sg WHERE sg.bestobjid = n.neighborobjid
  )
),
-- collect all photoobj.objid that should be considered galaxies via direct matches
photo_matches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(s.bestobjid, s.specobjid) AS match_objid
  FROM spec_gal s
  WHERE COALESCE(s.bestobjid, s.specobjid) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.objid,
       p.ra,
       p.dec,
       p.u,
       p.g,
       p.r,
       p.i,
       p.z
FROM photoobj p
WHERE p.type = (SELECT value FROM gal_photo_type_val)
  AND (p.u IS NOT NULL OR p.g IS NOT NULL OR p.r IS NOT NULL OR p.i IS NOT NULL OR p.z IS NOT NULL)
  AND (
    -- direct match to specobj.bestobjid
    p.objid IN (SELECT DISTINCT bestobjid FROM spec_gal WHERE bestobjid IS NOT NULL)
    -- or photoobj is the same as a specobj.specobjid
    OR p.objid IN (SELECT DISTINCT specobjid FROM spec_gal WHERE specobjid IS NOT NULL)
    -- or photoobj is a neighbor of a specobj.bestobjid
    OR p.objid IN (SELECT objid FROM neighbor_objids)
  )
ORDER BY p.objid ASC

rows.question: Show me the object id, right ascension and declination of photometrically observable Galaxy that have spectral observations.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH photo_type_codes AS (
  SELECT value, name
  FROM photo_type
),
objects_with_spectra AS (
  -- identify photoobj.objid that have any associated spectrum
  SELECT DISTINCT p.objid
  FROM photoobj p
  LEFT JOIN specobj s
    ON p.objid = s.bestobjid
  LEFT JOIN galspecline g
    ON s.specobjid = g.specobjid
  LEFT JOIN spplines sp
    ON s.specobjid = sp.specobjid
  WHERE s.specobjid IS NOT NULL    -- direct specobj row exists for the object (via bestobjid)
     OR g.specobjid IS NOT NULL    -- specobj referenced is present in galspecline
     OR sp.specobjid IS NOT NULL   -- specobj referenced is present in spplines
)
SELECT p.objid, p.ra, p.dec
FROM photoobj p
JOIN photo_type_codes pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
JOIN objects_with_spectra ows
  ON p.objid = ows.objid
WHERE pt.name = 'Galaxy'
  AND p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.objid

WITH photoobj_raw_measurements AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid AS objid,
    p.run AS run,
    p.rerun AS rerun,
    p.field AS field,
    p.mode AS mode,
    p.type AS type,
    p.clean AS clean,
    p.ra AS ra,
    p.dec AS dec,
    p.u AS u,
    p.g AS g,
    p.r AS r,
    p.i AS i,
    p.z AS z
  FROM photoobj p
),
photoobj_color_indices AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid,
    p.run,
    p.rerun,
    p.field,
    p.mode,
    p.type,
    p.clean,
    p.ra,
    p.dec,
    p.u,
    p.g,
    p.r,
    p.i,
    p.z,
    -- computed color indices: preserve NULL if any operand is NULL
    CASE WHEN p.u IS NULL OR p.g IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (p.u - p.g) END AS computed_u_minus_g,
    CASE WHEN p.g IS NULL OR p.r IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (p.g - p.r) END AS computed_g_minus_r,
    CASE WHEN p.r IS NULL OR p.i IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (p.r - p.i) END AS computed_r_minus_i,
    CASE WHEN p.i IS NULL OR p.z IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (p.i - p.z) END AS computed_i_minus_z
  FROM photoobj_raw_measurements p
)
SELECT
  objid,
  run,
  rerun,
  field,
  mode,
  type,
  clean,
  ra,
  dec,
  u,
  g,
  r,
  i,
  z,
  computed_u_minus_g,
  computed_g_minus_r,
  computed_r_minus_i,
  computed_i_minus_z
FROM photoobj_color_indices
WHERE u IS NOT NULL
  AND g IS NOT NULL
  AND r IS NOT NULL
  AND i IS NOT NULL
  AND z IS NOT NULL
  AND computed_u_minus_g < 0.4
  AND computed_g_minus_r < 0.7
  AND computed_r_minus_i > 0.4
  AND computed_i_minus_z > 0.4

    p.g::real AS g,
